title: Cuckoo
desc: Tamil and Kodi, a visually impaired couple, undergo many hardships to unite when they learn that Kodi's brother has decided to marry her off to someone else in return for a favour.

title: Vishwaroopam
desc: Nirupama hires a private investigator to keep a watch on her husband, Vishwanath. However, she is shocked to discover that there is more to him than meets the eye.

title: Kannum Kannum Kollaiyadithaal
desc: Siddharth and Kalli never seem to be short on money. However, when they meet the women of their dreams, they are pushed into reconsidering their career choices.

title: Tamizhukku En Ondrai Azhuthavum
desc: A tech-savvy person is given a task to fix the mobile connection of an entire city, unaware that the completion of it could activate a bomb explosion.

title: Subham
desc: The women of Bheemili are unusually transfixed by a soap opera serial. When three friends who run the cable in town decide to dig into the situation, they uncover unimaginable secrets.

title: Vettai
desc: An inspector covertly collaborates with his brother to discipline offenders, but when a gangster uncovers their secret, the officer resolves to train under his sibling to confront the criminal.
